reasoning: According to established molecular biology and public health authorities including the CDC, WHO, and NIH, mRNA vaccines do not alter, integrate into, or permanently change human DNA. mRNA delivered by vaccines functions strictly in the cytoplasm of the cell to instruct the ribosomes to produce harmless spike proteins. The mRNA does not enter the cell nucleus (where genomic DNA is housed) and naturally degrades quickly. Furthermore, human cells lack the enzymatic machinery (reverse transcriptase) required to transcribe mRNA back into genomic DNA. Claims alleging permanent genetic modification have been widely debunked as scientific misinformation.
